about: 'Say it out loud' lines for the Grade 5 units whose speaking tasks mark no double-quoted model line (sayitLines in app.config.json). Units 3, 7 and 9 take the model lines their own tasks already print, unquoted or in single quotes; Unit 10's capstone tasks print none, so its six are written here, one per task. Used only in this app, never written into the unit JSON. Written 2026-09-11; Unit 10's lines need curriculum review.
